还没等她出去寻找，就看到小石头自己走了进来。
小石头眼中燃烧着熊熊火焰，陈小草清楚的感知到，那是和她一样的情绪。
那是浓烈到化不开的复仇焰火。
陈小草没有问小石头去哪儿了。
只是伸出手将她一并揽入怀里。
一大八小，就这么挤在一起，沉沉睡去。
次日，陈小草端坐在板凳上，目光扫过眼前八个坐的同样端正的身躯。
院长奶奶最开始只是收养了她一个，她是最大的孩子，今年18岁。
那个时候，孤儿院还不叫孤儿院，只是院长奶奶和她两个人的家。
在她三岁左右的时候，院长奶奶又捡到了同样在襁褓中的陈石头。
这才决定成立孤儿院。
陈石头是第二大的孩子，今年15岁。
后来，孩子越捡越多，孤儿院也越来越热闹。
老三陈息壤，老四陈木根，老五陈炎艳，老六陈淼淼。
要说院长奶奶有强迫症吧。。。兄弟姐妹们没一个名字带金的。
要说没有吧。。。这五行都硬凑了四个出来。
后来的名字总算没那么接地气了。
小七陈千帆，小八陈清欢。
他俩的名字，是孤儿院里人人都羡慕的存在。

至于年仅五岁的小九。
她是陈小草捡回来的。
陈小草叫她陈小花。
陈小草和院长奶奶说。
孤儿院的日子会越过越好的，孤儿院也是时候开出一朵小花了。
看着看着，陈小草的眼泪又下来了。
花苞正开，而奶奶不在。
她。。。再也看不见了。
孩子们看着陈小草哭，他们也跟着哭。
陈小草没有出声，他们也哭的抽抽噎噎，不敢出声。
哭了一阵，陈小草觉得胸口没那么闷了。
她用力搓了搓自己的脸，努力挤出一个笑容，看着八个孩子们，一字一句的道。
“好了，不哭了。”

Before she went out to search, she saw Xiao Shitou walking in on his own.
Xiao Shitou's eyes were burning with blazing fire, and Chen Xiaocao clearly felt that it was the same emotion as hers.
It was a firework of revenge that was so strong that it couldn't be melted away.
Chen Xiaocao didn't ask where the little stone went.
He just stretched out his hand and took her into his arms.
One and eight children, just huddled together like this and fell asleep.
The next day, Chen Xiaocao sat on the bench and glanced at the eight similarly upright bodies in front of him.
The dean's grandma only adopted her as her first child. She is the eldest child and is 18 years old this year.
At that time, the orphanage was not called an orphanage, it was just the home of the director and her grandmother.
When she was about three years old, the dean's grandmother picked up Chen Shitou, who was also in her infancy.
It was then decided to set up an orphanage.
Chen Shitou is the second eldest child, 15 years old this year.
Later, more and more children were picked up, and the orphanage became more and more lively.
The third child is Chen Xirang, the fourth child is Chen Mugen, the fifth child is Chen Yanyan, and the sixth child is Chen Miaomiao.
I would say that Grandma Dean has obsessive-compulsive disorder. . . None of the brothers and sisters have gold in their names.
I would say no. . . Four of these five elements were cobbled together.
Later names finally became less down-to-earth.
Xiaoqi Chen Qianfan, Xiaoba Chen Qinghuan.
Their names are the envy of everyone in the orphanage.
As for Xiao Jiu, who is only five years old.
She was picked up by Chen Xiaocao.
Chen Xiaocao called her Chen Xiaohua.
Chen Xiaocao said to the dean’s grandma.
The life of the orphanage will get better and better, and it's time for the orphanage to bloom a little flower.
As he watched, Chen Xiaocao's tears fell again.
The buds are blooming, but grandma is not here.
she. . . Never seen again.
The children watched Chen Xiaocao cry, and they cried too.
Chen Xiaocao didn't make a sound, and they also cried and choked, not daring to make a sound.
After crying for a while, Chen Xiaocao felt that his chest was no longer so tight.
She rubbed her face vigorously, tried hard to smile, looked at the eight children, and spoke word by word.
"Okay, don't cry anymore."
